title: Wave Technologies
seo_title: Wave Technology Worksheets: Sonar, Fiber Optics, GPS and Noise Cancelling (Physics)
standard_text: Communicate technical information about how some technological devices use the principles of wave behavior and wave interactions with matter to transmit and capture information and energy.
meta_desc: Free high school physics worksheets on wave technologies (NGSS HS-PS4-5): sonar and ultrasound echoes, radar and GPS timing, fiber optics, interference and solar cells. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Devices use waves to send information.
key_sub: Echoes measure distance; light, radio and interference carry and clean up signals.
body_html:
How to think about it

Technology uses waves to carry information and energy.

  • Echoes (sonar, ultrasound, radar): distance = speed × time ÷ 2.
  • Fiber optics trap light by total internal reflection; noise cancelling uses destructive interference.
  • Radio, microwaves and light all travel at 3.0 × 108 m/s; sound is much slower.
Example

Sonar echo after 2 s in water (1,480 m/s)?

1,480 × 2 ÷ 2

Answer: 1,480 m

Example

Amplitudes 4 cm and 3 cm, crest meets trough?

4 − 3

Answer: 1 cm

Common mistakes

  • Forgetting to halve the echo time.
  • Thinking fiber optics carry electricity.
  • Thinking radio waves travel at the speed of sound.
